description: Urban Development Authority - Amendment Plan for the Galle Port Archaeological Conservation Zone of Greater Galle Development Plan 2021 - 2031
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the approval of amendments to planning regulations and guidelines for a specific archaeological conservation zone under the Urban Development Authority Law. It focuses on regulatory changes and legal authority (citing specific acts and sections) rather than government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or other specialized categories. The mention of the minister is incidental to the regulatory action being taken.
